MINUTES
  Special Meeting
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  April 30, 2026
  11:00 a.m.

 ROLL CALL: At 11:36 a.m., on Thursday, April 30, 2026, the Alhambra City Council met in the
 Ballroom of The Granada LA located at 17 South First Street, Alhambra, California.

 CITY COUNCIL:  PRESENT:  LEE, MAZA, WANG, ANDRADE-STADLER, MALONEY
  ABSENT:  NONE

 Officials Present: City Manager Binnquist, Assistant City Manager Garcia, City Attorney Montes, City
 Clerk Myles, Director of Parks & Recreation Macias, Director of Library Services LohGuan, Director of
 Public Works/Utilities Ahlen, Director of Finance Lieu, Director of Human Resources Ko, Director of
 Community Development Ho, Fire Chief Ragusa, Chief of Police Kennedy

 CITY CLERK REPORT - NOTICE NO. N2M26-55

 The City Clerk reported that she duly gave notice of the special meeting of the City Council being held
 this morning pursuant to the order of the Mayor and in accordance with Section 54956 of the
 Government Code of the State of California.

1.  CITY OF ALHAMBRA: STATE OF THE CITY ADDRESS – F2M26-16

  Mayor MALONEY presented the State of the City address and provided insight on the current
  state of the City and the progress that has been made over the past year. A copy of the
  presentation is on file in the City Clerk’s Office.

  Public Comment:  None

  Discussion:  None

ADJOURNMENT:  At 12:20 p.m., Mayor MALONEY adjourned the meeting.

  LAUREN MYLES, CMC
  CITY CLERK

4-30-26  1
